title: Unified Digital Portal for Syrian Universities
problem: University services were fragmented across separate processes, making registration and student workflows difficult to coordinate at scale.
solution: A unified digital portal that centralizes university services and automates high-volume registration workflows.
architecture: Clean Architecture with DTOs, Repository Contracts, Service Layers, Enums, Policies, and Custom Responses.
challenges: Sustaining high concurrency during registration peaks.
Processing events asynchronously while protecting API reliability.
keyHighlights: Graduation Project: Architected and developed the backend for a unified digital portal automating university services.
Implemented Clean Architecture using DTOs, Repository Contracts, Service Layers, Enums, Policies, and Custom Responses.
Integrated Laravel Jobs & Listeners with Redis queues for asynchronous event processing alongside Connection Pooling and Rate Limiting.
Built automated CI/CD pipelines for deployment.

detailedSections.heading: Architectural Overview
detailedSections.content: Built following Clean Architecture principles to decouple core domain logic from framework dependencies using DTOs, Repository Contracts, and Service Layers.

detailedSections.heading: Performance & Async Infrastructure
detailedSections.content: Utilized Redis for queue management, caching, connection pooling, and rate limiting middleware to sustain high concurrency during registration peaks.

detailedSections.heading: Delivery & Deployment
detailedSections.content: Integrated Laravel Jobs & Listeners with Redis queues for asynchronous event processing and built automated CI/CD pipelines for deployment.

title: Information Retrieval & Search Engine System
problem: Searching a large document collection across sparse, probabilistic, semantic, and hybrid retrieval approaches required a consistent evaluation system.
solution: A modular SOA search engine that benchmarks multiple retrieval strategies and combines their results.
architecture: Service-oriented modules for indexing, retrieval, evaluation, and visualization, backed by SQLite and FAISS vector indexing.
challenges: Reducing semantic query latency while preserving retrieval quality.
keyHighlights: Engineered an SOA modular search engine processing 382k+ documents (BEIR Touche-2020 dataset).
Benchmarked Sparse VSM (TF-IDF), Probabilistic BM25, Deep Semantic Embeddings (BERT), and Hybrid CombSUM/Serial RRF Search.
Fine-tuned BM25 hyperparameters (k1=2.0, b=0.60) achieving peak MAP@10 = 0.1470 and Precision@10 = 76.12%.
Integrated FAISS vector store with mmap/float32 indexing, reducing BERT query latency from ~1.5s to ~0.1s.

detailedSections.heading: Vector Indexing & Optimization
detailedSections.content: Integrated FAISS with L2 normalization and memory-mapped files (mmap, float32) to drastically cut semantic vector query latency from ~1.5s down to ~0.1s.

detailedSections.heading: Retrieval Models & Analytics
detailedSections.content: Implemented and benchmarked Sparse Vector Space Model (TF-IDF), Probabilistic BM25, Deep Semantic Embeddings (BERT/all-MiniLM-L6-v2), and Hybrid CombSUM/Serial RRF search models. Built full NLTK preprocessing pipelines with stemming, Unicode normalization, and field-weighted titling alongside a dynamic Chart.js analytics interface using Flask Blueprints.

title: Complaints Management System
problem: Citizens and municipal teams needed a reliable way to submit, process, and audit service complaints.
solution: A scalable backend for complaint intake, workflow processing, and traceable municipal requests.
architecture: Laravel REST API using Redis caching, session management, queues, rate limiting, and audit tracing.
challenges: Maintaining reliable request processing under variable demand.
Keeping complaint history traceable across workflow changes.
keyHighlights: Developed a scalable backend system for citizen complaints and municipal requests.
Leveraged Redis caching, session management, message queues, rate-limiting protocols, and audit tracing for high reliability.

detailedSections.heading: Reliability & Availability
detailedSections.content: Developed a scalable backend system for handling citizen complaints and municipal requests, applying high-performance web architecture concepts. Leveraged Redis caching, session management, message queues, rate-limiting protocols, and audit tracing for high reliability and availability.

title: Custom ANTLR-to-Web Compiler & Transpiler
problem: Custom grammar specifications needed to become executable web output through a complete compiler pipeline.
solution: A multi-stage compiler and transpiler that converts grammar input into HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
architecture: A staged compiler architecture covering lexical analysis, AST parsing, semantic analysis, and code generation.
challenges: Maintaining correct state between compilation stages.
Generating valid coordinated output across three web languages.
keyHighlights: Built a full multi-stage compiler that converts custom ANTLR-like grammar specifications directly into executable HTML, CSS, and JS.
Engineered full compilation pipeline: Lexical Analysis (Lexer), Parsing (AST construction), Semantic Analysis, and Code Generation.

detailedSections.heading: Compilation Pipeline
detailedSections.content: Built a full multi-stage compiler that converts custom ANTLR-like grammar specifications directly into executable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for browser environments. Designed and implemented Lexical Analysis (Lexer), Parsing (AST construction), Semantic Analysis, and Target Code Generation.

title: MatchLab - Medical Laboratories Management System
problem: Medical laboratories need coordinated workflows for multiple actors while protecting sensitive patient data.
solution: A multi-actor laboratory management platform with secure workflows for patients, technicians, and administrators.
architecture: Laravel REST API with role-based access control separating permissions across the platform actors.
challenges: Protecting sensitive medical information across role boundaries.
Supporting distinct workflows for each platform actor.
keyHighlights: Engineered a multi-actor backend platform for medical analysis laboratories.
Implemented Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across Patients, Technicians, and Admins to secure sensitive medical data.

detailedSections.heading: Roles & Medical Workflows
detailedSections.content: Engineered a multi-actor backend platform for medical analysis laboratories to manage patient records, test results, and lab workflow statuses. Implemented role-based access control for Patients, Technicians, and Admins to secure sensitive medical data.

title: Ludo Star Console Game with AI & Expectimax
problem: A console Ludo game needed an intelligent opponent and clear real-time board state updates.
solution: A CLI game with ANSI-rendered state updates and Expectimax-based AI decision making.
architecture: Object-oriented game state and decision layers with Expectimax and Alpha-Beta pruning.
challenges: Representing changing board states clearly in a terminal.
Balancing AI search quality with practical move selection time.
keyHighlights: Engineered CLI Ludo Star with dynamic ANSI color-rendered board state updates.
Implemented Expectimax (ExpVal) decision-making with Alpha-Beta pruning for optimal AI moves.

detailedSections.heading: Game Architecture & AI
detailedSections.content: Engineered a multi-mode CLI implementation of Ludo Star for Player vs Player and Player vs AI with dynamic ANSI color-rendered board state updates. Applied Object-Oriented Programming to board mechanics, player states, turn validation, and state-space tree traversals, then implemented Expectimax decision-making with Alpha-Beta pruning to model probabilistic dice outcomes and optimal strategy.

title: Light Link Mirror - Algorithmic Puzzle & Pathfinder
problem: Puzzle levels required a reliable way to model optical ray interactions and discover solutions automatically.
solution: A CLI puzzle game with automated ray-casting and a heuristic pathfinder for level solving.
architecture: State-space modeling combined with heuristic search and deterministic puzzle simulation.
challenges: Modeling reflected ray paths across changing board states.
Finding useful solutions without exhausting the search space.
keyHighlights: Built a single-player CLI puzzle game featuring automated optical ray-casting.
Engineered an AI pathfinder utilizing heuristic state-space search to solve levels automatically.

detailedSections.heading: Pathfinding & Simulation
detailedSections.content: Built a single-player CLI puzzle game featuring automated optical ray-casting and board state-space rendering. Engineered an AI pathfinder and solver using state evaluation logic and heuristic graph search to calculate optimal reflection trajectories and solve levels automatically. Applied object-oriented design to dynamic grid management, mirror rotation mechanics, and light-beam path verification.

title: TRAVANIX - Tourism Management System
problem: Travel customers need connected booking workflows spanning trips, hotel rooms, and activities.
solution: A tourism backend that coordinates composite bookings and location-based destination information.
architecture: Laravel REST API with relational booking workflows and map-integrated location services.
challenges: Connecting location data to hotels, venues, and destinations.
keyHighlights: Built a backend tourism platform with composite booking workflows for trips, hotel rooms, and activities.
Integrated location-based mapping features for hotels, venues, and destinations.

detailedSections.heading: Booking & Account Workflows
detailedSections.content: Built a multi-featured backend tourism platform enabling users to browse curated trips, manage composite bookings for entire trips, individual hotel rooms, or activities, and track real-time booking status workflows with admin orchestration. Implemented account management, dynamic trip and venue filtering, favorites tracking, user ratings, nested comments, and location-based mapping for hotels, restaurants, and activity destinations.

title: Medixify - Pharmacy & Warehouse Ecosystem
problem: Pharmaceutical suppliers and retail pharmacies need shared stock visibility and reliable batch tracking.
solution: A connected pharmacy and warehouse ecosystem with medicine discovery and automated stock calculations.
architecture: Laravel REST API with relational inventory, supplier, pharmacy, batch, and medicine workflows.
challenges: Keeping stock calculations accurate as batches change.
Supporting fast medicine search and filtering across inventory.
keyHighlights: Developed a pharmaceutical ecosystem connecting suppliers with retail pharmacies.
Implemented dynamic batch tracking, medicine search/filtering, and automated stock calculations.

detailedSections.heading: Inventory & Authorization
detailedSections.content: Designed and developed a pharmaceutical ecosystem connecting medicine suppliers and warehouses with retail pharmacies to streamline drug distribution and order management. Implemented dynamic batch tracking, medicine search and filtering, automated stock calculations, real-time order processing, and role-specific authorization for warehouse managers and pharmacists.
